target.title: fix(workboard): prevent custom select menu flash to top-left before positioning
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves When clicking a custom `
`-based select (status, priority, agent, session) inside the workboard card modal, the dropdown menu briefly flashes at the viewport origin before jumping to the correct position. Root cause: `positionWorkboardSelectMenu` computes and applies CSS custom properties synchronously during `@toggle`, but the menu's CSS default (`top: 0; left: 0`) may be painted for one frame before the JS-delivered values take effect. ## Why This Change Was Made Set `visibility: hidden` as the menu's default CSS state. After positioning values are applied, toggle `visibility: visible` in the same synchronous handler. `visibility: hidden` keeps the element in layout so `getBoundingClientRect` returns correct measurements, unlike `display: none` which would remove it from layout entirely. ## User Impact Custom select dropdowns in the workboard card-modal form now appear directly at their correct position with no flash. ## Evidence ### Existing regression tests ``` $ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/workboard/view.test.ts Test Files 1 passed (1) Tests 70 passed (70) ``` ### After fix ### Fix invariants | State | CSS | Effect | |-------|-----|--------| | Default (closed) | `display: none` + `visibility: hidden` | Not in layout, not painted | | `[open]` fires | `display: grid` (CSS) + `visibility: hidden` (inline) | In layout, not painted | | After positioning | `--top`/`--left` set + `visibility: visible` | In layout, painted at correct position | | Close | `display: none` + `visibility: hidden` | Reset for next open | ### Files Changed (2 files, +3 lines) ``` ui/src/pages/workboard/view.ts | 2 ++ ui/src/styles/workboard.css | 1 + ```
